postToolUse.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); exit(0 if str(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','')).endswith('.py') else 1)" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && uv run pytest tests/ -m 'not integration' -x -q --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -10 || true
postToolUse.description: Run unit tests after editing Python source files
